clauses.why: The verses give Doeg's report that he saw David come to Nob to Ahimelech; verse 10 describes Ahimelech's deeds, so it should not be cited, and the report does not say David 'came to' him 'at Nob' in those words only.
clauses.english: told Saul he had seen David come to Ahimelech at Nob
clauses.ukr: сказав, що бачив Давида, який приходив до Нова, до Ахімелеха
clauses.deu: sagte, er habe David gesehen, wie er nach Nobe zu Ahimelech kam
clauses.spa: dijo que había visto a David venir a Nob, a Ahimelech

clauses.english: slew eighty-five priests at Saul's command
clauses.ukr: вбив вісімдесят п'ять священиків за наказом Саула
clauses.deu: erschlug auf Befehl Sauls fünfundachtzig Priester
clauses.spa: mató a ochenta y cinco sacerdotes por orden de Saúl

answer.note: The line omits that Doeg also struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the sword (1SA 22:19), though it is not shown that he did it himself.
